about: Almeyda Law, P.A. is a immigration firm with a single office in Coral Gables.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

G1.evidence: Florida does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: 1 of the firm's attorneys share a surname with a disciplined attorney, and for Rey Hernandez 2 of 2 decision(s) naming this surname have no searchable text, so they can be neither tied to nor ruled out against this attorney. The decisions that cannot be read are scans without searchable text, so this is a limit of the published record. Nothing here says the firm's attorney is that person.

G3.evidence: No matching active entity in the Florida corporate register. Florida does not require a sole proprietorship or a general partnership to register, so this is a check we could not complete from this source rather than evidence against the firm
G3.source: Corporate Data File, quarterly full snapshot, published by the Florida Department of State Division of Corporations, partial
G3.unresolvable: Florida does not require every law firm to register, so this register cannot answer for one that is not obliged to appear in it

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 2 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 129 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2014-03-12, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
